long_biography.plain_text:
Laboratorios Roemmers began in Buenos Aires in 1921, when Alfredo's grandfather, Alberto J. Roemmers, established the pharmaceutical company. His father, Alberto W. H. Roemmers, later led it for more than five decades and built its position in prescription medicines. Alfredo Pablo belongs to the third generation and served as a company director before his father's death.

He and his brother Alberto hold leading interests in the family holding company that controls Roemmers and associated pharmaceutical investments. The structure also connects them indirectly to other medicine manufacturers, keeping healthcare at the center of Alfredo's documented business interests. His role is best understood as family shareholder and wealth custodian; the laboratory's operations are professionally managed rather than directed by him as chief executive.

Alfredo Pablo Roemmers is the son of the late Argentinean billionaire Alberto Roemmers. The Roemmers family is the owner of Laboratorios Roemmers, which is one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in Latin America. Their focus lies in the production of various drugs, including antibiotics and anti-inflammatory treatments. The company is also recognized as one of the top 50 global manufacturers of generic drugs.

Previously, Alberto Roemmers owned a 30m Wally sailing yacht named Alexia. Despite the removal of the sales listing for Alexia in October 2022, the yacht has continued to operate under the same name and tracking signal as of June 2023. Therefore, it is probable that Alexia has remained in the possession of the Roemmers family.
